title: Honey-Glazed Double Haloumi Burger
subtitle: with Tomato Relish & Potato Crisps
description: Sweet and salty haloumi, a quick tomato relish and crisp potato rounds - this is a burger and chips with a twist!

steps.text:
• Preheat oven to 240°C/220°C fan-forced.
• Slice haloumi horizontally to get 1 piece per person. Transfer to a medium bowl and cover with water to soak.
• Thinly slice potato into rounds.
• Place potato rounds on lined oven tray. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and toss to coat.
• Bake until tender, 20-25 mins.

• Meanwhile, thinly slice brown onion (see ingredients). Roughly chop tomato.
• In a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat.
• Cook onion and tomato, stirring, until softened, 5-6 mins. Reduce heat to medium.
• Add the balsamic vinegar, brown sugar and water and mix well. Cook until dark and sticky, 3-5 mins. Transfer to a small bowl.

• Drain haloumi and pat dry.
• Wash out frying pan and return to medium-high heat with a drizzle of olive oil.
• Cook haloumi until golden brown, 2 mins each side (cook in batches if your pan is getting crowded).
• Remove from heat, then add the honey, turning to coat.

• Meanwhile, halve continental rolls and bake directly on a wire oven rack until heated through, 2-3 mins.
• Top continental rolls with the mayonnaise, tomato relish, haloumi and baby spinach.
• Serve with potato crisps.
